stories.title: Trump set to deliver SOTU address amid high stakes moment both at home and abroad
stories.summary: President Trump is expected to deliver a lengthy defense of the first year of his second term and make the case for his party ahead of the midterms in his speech Tuesday.

stories.title: Indian prime minister Modi is set to visit Israel at a perilous moment in time
stories.summary: The Indian prime minister will meet his Israeli counterpart in Israel this week amid a rapidly shifting geopolitical crisis.

stories.title: Savannah Guthrie offers $1 million reward for information about missing mother Nancy
stories.summary: In an emotional video plea, Savannah Guthrie announced a $1 million family reward for her mother, Nancy's, recovery.

stories.title: Remembering actor Robert Carradine, a reluctant nerd on screen
stories.summary: The actor Robert Carradine, famous for roles in Revenge of the Nerds and Lizzie McGuire — among more serious parts — has died. He was 71.

stories.title: Under social pressure, young clownfish lose their stripes faster, study finds
stories.summary: Tomato clownfish appear to adjust the stripes on their bodies in response to social pressures, a new study finds.

stories.title: Will American shoppers get a tariff refund?
stories.summary: Americans paid for tariffs. They shouldn't expect their money back.
